name: United Kingdom
visaRequirements: Not in the Schengen Area — a separate UK visa or ETA is required for many visitors
bestExperience: Best experience: the Warner Bros. Harry Potter studio tour, hands down.

about.description: London is big in a way that catches people out — it is less a city you walk than a set of neighbourhoods joined by the Underground, and the distances between the things you want to see are the main thing to plan around. The major museums are free, which does more for a budget here than anything else.
highlights: Free entry to the British Museum and the Natural History Museum
Westminster, Big Ben and the Abbey
The Warner Bros. Studio Tour for the Harry Potter films
Greenwich, Camden and the neighbourhoods away from the centre
Wembley Stadium and the Sherlock Holmes Museum for the specific pilgrimages

travelTips.bestTimeToVisit: May to September for the best weather and the longest days
transportation: The Underground is the only sensible way to cross the city
Contactless card or phone taps in and out — no need to buy tickets
Book the Warner Bros. Studio Tour well in advance; it sells out
culturalNotes: Not in the Schengen Area — check entry requirements separately from the EU
Stand on the right on escalators
Most national museums are free, but special exhibitions are not
